product.description: Allows users to enter stadiums using their mobile phones, eliminating the need for printed tickets and reducing waiting lines.

product.description: Enables users to order food and drinks to be delivered to their seats or available for express pick-up.

product.name: Team Merchandise
product.description: Provides a platform for purchasing team gear, with options for home delivery or stadium pick-up.
